function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

• Explain concepts step‑by‑step (e.g., how photosynthesis works).
• Summarize articles or books. | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, reports, essays, or creative stories.
• Proofread and suggest style improvements.
• Generate outlines or bullet points. | | **Programming & Tech Support** | • Write code snippets in Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL, etc.
• Debug simple errors or explain error messages.

• Compare flight options or find local attractions. | | **Health & Wellness** | • Share general wellness advice (nutrition, exercise, mindfulness).
• Clarify medical terms (but not a substitute for professional diagnosis). | | **Entertainment & Recommendations** | • Recommend movies, books, music based on your taste.
• Create quizzes or trivia games. | | **Daily Life & Productivity** | • Help organize schedules, set reminders, or create to‑do lists.
• Offer time‑management techniques. | If you have a specific task in mind—or just want to explore something new—just let me know! What would you like to tackle today?
